using Makie

function solve!(plot::AbstractPlot, x::AbstractVector, y::AbstractVector, colors::AbstractVector)
    # Ensure x and y have the same length
    if length(x) != length(y)
        throw(ArgumentError("x and y must have the same length"))
    end
    if length(x) != length(colors)
        throw(ArgumentError("x, y, and colors must have the same length"))
    end

    # Update the scatter plot with new data
    Makie.update!(plot, :data, [x, y], :color, colors)
    return plot
end
